title: Couples Money Conversation Cards and Money Date Planner, Couples Budget Spreadsheet, Fair Bill Split by Income, Relationship Finance Kit
description:
Talk about money without the fight, then turn the talk into a plan you both agreed to. The complete version of our bestselling Couples Money Conversation Starter.

WHAT YOU GET
1. The Conversation Starter, in full (quiz, couple type pairing, Ground Rules), plus the 20 conversation cards as a printable cut-out sheet.
2. 4-Week Money Date Plan (fillable PDF): four 20-minute dates, each with an agenda, cards to pull, a timer plan and an agreement box.
3. Couples Money Date Planner (Excel + Google Sheets, example + blank): Dashboard, joint bills, spending plan, shared goals, a log of every money date.
4. Monthly money check-in with guided reflection questions: your month in plain words, plus a printable page.

Unlike our Premarital Money Talks workbook, this kit is built around the cards and timed money dates, for couples at any stage.

HOW IT FIXES COMMON COMPLAINTS
- Thin question lists ("you get what you pay for"): 20 deep cards in a set order, not 100 shallow questions.
- No idea where to start? A written start, date by date.
- Who pays what? Bills split fairly by income, or 50/50, or your own %.
- Broken formulas? Formulas are locked; you only type in yellow boxes.
